items.title: Astera Labs Stock Drops 26% in a Week Despite Strong Earnings. Is It a Buy Now?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAstera Labs (ALAB) fell 26% over five trading sessions, closing at $191 on November 6 despite record third-quarter revenue and strong guidance. Marvell Technology (MRVL) announced a $115 billion acquisition agreement, while Intel (INTC) reported 78% Data Center and AI revenue growth and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) posted 97% data center growth.

items.title: Coherent Is Up 21% in a Year as AI Goes “From Copper to Optical.” Is It a Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent stock is up 21% in the past year, but it’s about 56% below the peak it set in June, a run helped by Nvidia’s $2 billion investment. Revenue rose 50% in the September quarter, management now expects fiscal 2027 pro forma revenue growth above 60%, and it signed a PhotonLink deal valued at about $20 billion.
